Undergraduate Scholarships for Myanmar Students

Browse scholarships by destination and university. Check Myanmar nationality eligibility, funding, application timing, obligations and official sources.

Explore this first collection of official undergraduate scholarship information by destination and university. Review nationality, qualifications, grades, programme and applicant-status conditions, together with each listing’s research status.

Chinese Government Scholarship: Bilateral Program (Type A)

Chinese government / CSC and dispatching authorities · China

Eligibility
Foreign undergraduate applicants apply through their home-country authority and must meet university, CSC and country rules. Check the intake’s CSCA, age and language conditions; Myanmar’s 2027 quota is not verified here.
Funding
Approved funding may cover tuition, accommodation, medical insurance and a living allowance; the award notice governs.
How to apply
Check with the Chinese embassy/consulate or dispatching authority, select Type A in the CSC system, and complete university admission separately.
Renewal & obligations
University assessment and annual scholarship review apply; renewal is not automatic.
Application timing
Tsinghua lists a usual November 2026–April 2027 period, varying by country. Myanmar’s opening and deadline remain unverified.
  • PKU 2026 Undergraduate Entrance Examination: Scholarships ↗
  • Tsinghua Freshmen Scholarships: updated 2027 guidance ↗

PKU Scholarship for International Students (2026 entrance-exam route)

Peking University · China

Eligibility
Eligible admitted international undergraduates are assessed competitively; academic, nationality, age and entrance-exam requirements still apply.
Funding
Full or partial tuition waiver, medical insurance and living support; amounts depend on the award.
How to apply
Considered through undergraduate selection without a separate scholarship application.
Renewal & obligations
Annual review is required; consult university and award terms for continuation.
Application timing
The 2026 examination-route deadline was 28 February and has passed; check the new guide for 2027.
Listed deadline
2026-02-28
  • PKU 2026 Undergraduate Entrance Examination: Scholarships ↗

Tsinghua International Undergraduate Freshmen Scholarship

Tsinghua University and donors · China

Eligibility
Outstanding international undergraduate freshmen compete for awards and must meet 2027 academic, nationality and language requirements. A language score alone does not secure funding.
Funding
Full, half or partial tuition support for the first academic year.
How to apply
Apply through Tsinghua’s application system; selection is competitive.
Renewal & obligations
Freshman awards of the same type cannot be combined. In years 2–4, other scholarships require application and performance review.
Application timing
2027 guidance is published; confirm the program round and scholarship-system opening. This record is not marked open.
  • Tsinghua Freshmen Scholarships: updated 2027 guidance ↗

XMU New International Students Scholarship — 2026 Bachelor’s

Xiamen University · China

Eligibility
International undergraduate applicants need programme eligibility and a high-school diploma. English rules say under 25 at 1 September; Chinese wording allows 25, so confirm boundary-age cases.
Funding
Tuition only; five bachelor awards listed for 2026, without postgraduate stipends.
How to apply
Apply for admission and upload the signed award form; selection follows admission.
Renewal & obligations
Four or five undergraduate years, conditional on annual review.
Application timing
Closed on 10 April 2026; confirm the 2027 call.
Listed deadline
2026-04-10
  • XMU — New International Students Scholarships for 2026 ↗
  • XMU — 国际学生新生奖学金 ↗

HKU Computing and Data Science Entrance Scholarship

The University of Hong Kong · China

Eligibility
Local and non-local freshmen admitted to specified undergraduate programs of the School in 2026/27, with outstanding public-exam results; program and English admission conditions still apply.
Funding
HK$200,000 in total, paid in four equal annual instalments.
How to apply
No separate application; eligible students are automatically considered.
Renewal & obligations
Disbursement, academic and other commitments follow the award terms; no universal service bond was stated in the page read.
Application timing
The page expressly covers 2026 admission and says 2027 terms may change; the 2026 freshman cycle has passed.
  • HKU School of Computing and Data Science Entrance Scholarship ↗

CUHK Undergraduate Admission Scholarships

The Chinese University of Hong Kong · China

Eligibility
Local and non-local undergraduate freshmen are selected for academic or non-academic excellence; admission and English requirements are assessed separately.
Funding
Awards range from partial support to full tuition, with allowances for some awards; terms vary.
How to apply
No separate application; the university identifies and notifies selected recipients.
Renewal & obligations
Many awards are renewable during normal study subject to satisfactory academic progress; any commitments follow the award notice.
Application timing
The general scheme is published on an ongoing basis; confirm specific 2027 awards and admission deadlines.

HKUST Academic Admissions Scholarships — 2027 Priority Round

Hong Kong University of Science and Technology · China

Eligibility
Outstanding applicants from different backgrounds and qualifications are considered; general, program and English admission requirements still apply.
Funding
Amount and tuition/living support vary by qualification and award; consult the applicable scheme.
How to apply
All applicants are considered for academic scholarships without a separate application; non-academic awards require separate applications.
Renewal & obligations
Check whether the award is one-off, its renewal grades and commitments in the scheme and offer.
Application timing
2027/28 undergraduate applications are open. The priority round closes on 25 November 2026; the open status here refers only to that round. Check later rounds and specific award rules separately.
Listed deadline
2026-11-25

UM International Student Scholarship (Bachelor Students)

University of Macau · China

Eligibility
Outstanding international undergraduates; this category excludes mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan students. Foreign-passport, qualification and language admission rules still require review.
Funding
Full or half waiver of tuition and residential-college fees, depending on the award.
How to apply
Awarded competitively on undergraduate admission; confirm the current procedure and next-cycle dates with the Registry.
Renewal & obligations
Continuation during normal study requires the specified academic and residential-college conditions.
Application timing
The general scheme is verified; 2027 dates and quotas are not. HTML access was restricted; official calendar evidence is retained.

Zhejiang Government Scholarship — ZJU Undergraduate Freshmen

Zhejiang Government / Zhejiang University · China

Eligibility
Eligible international bachelor applicants in Chinese-taught programmes, with strong grades and no concurrent scholarship.
Funding
RMB 20,000 for one year.
How to apply
Upload the award form with admission; university nomination follows document and interview review.
Renewal & obligations
Strong current students may reapply; no concurrent scholarship or automatic renewal.
Application timing
2026 cycle closed. Chinese-language major lists 31 May; another deadline year has a source typo. Confirm with ZJU and await 2027 rules.

Hong Kong Belt and Road Scholarship — Designated Countries

Hong Kong Education Bureau · China

Eligibility
Myanmar included; outstanding first-year non-local students in publicly-funded Hong Kong bachelor programmes. Not for Macao courses.
Funding
Full tuition for normal programme duration.
How to apply
Confirm selection/nomination with the admitting university.
Renewal & obligations
Annual renewal requires satisfactory academic performance.
Application timing
Standing scheme; confirm 2027 dates and quotas with the university.

MOE Taiwan Scholarship — Bachelor’s

Taiwan Ministry of Education · China

Eligibility
Foreign high-school graduates need strong academic records and good conduct; overseas Chinese students and certain prior/current Taiwan students are excluded. Mission rules govern TOCFL Level 3 evidence or permitted later submission for non-English programmes, and accepted English evidence for fully English programmes.
Funding
Up to NTD 40,000 per semester for eligible tuition/fees, plus NTD 15,000 monthly for up to four undergraduate years. Excess and excluded costs remain payable.
How to apply
Apply through the mission responsible for your citizenship and separately apply to a university. The official system lists Myanmar without available dates; confirm the current responsible mission and allocation with the MOE programme office.
Renewal & obligations
Maintain academic, attendance and language requirements. Other Taiwan government/institution awards are generally incompatible, apart from permitted tuition-gap subsidies.
Application timing
Myanmar’s 2027 call and deadline are unverified; the system currently shows no opening. Follow the responsible mission’s new announcement.
  • MOE — Taiwan Scholarship Program ↗
  • MOE — Taiwan Scholarship Directions ↗
  • MOE — Applications by Mission and Country ↗
  • NTHU OGA — Scholarships for International Students ↗

NTU International Undergraduate Student Scholarship

National Taiwan University · China

Eligibility
International undergraduate degree applicants may apply; Taiwan Scholarship recipients should not apply.
Funding
Up to NTD 100,000 tuition subsidy per semester and NTD 8,000 monthly; excluded charges include accommodation and other specified costs.
How to apply
Tick the scholarship box in the degree application; no separate procedure.
Renewal & obligations
Maintain annual GPA of at least 3.38; admission deferral forfeits the award.
Application timing
Standing scheme tied to the admission cycle; maximum duration follows the programme’s designated study period.
  • NTU — Scholarships for International Undergraduate Students ↗

NTHU International Student Scholarship — Bachelor’s

NTHU Office of Global Affairs · China

Eligibility
Foreign degree students; excludes the Taipei School of Economics and Political Science and College of Semiconductor Research.
Funding
Category A covers tuition/required fees plus NTD 5,000 monthly for undergraduates; Category B covers fees only.
How to apply
New applicants select the scholarship in the admission system for university review.
Renewal & obligations
Awards last one year, up to four undergraduate years, subject to academic renewal review; eligible renewals may waive reapplication. Check current rules before combining funding.
Application timing
Standing scheme; new students follow admissions, current students follow OGA notices.

  • NTHU — International Student Scholarship ↗
  • NTHU IBP — Scholarship Application and Renewal ↗

NYCU International Student Scholarship — Bachelor’s

National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University · China

Eligibility
International degree students may apply; current undergraduates need cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 and no Taiwan government award.
Funding
Stipend and tuition support may be awarded together or separately; tuition support may be a waiver or local-student rate. Amount follows the award letter.
How to apply
New applicants select it with admission; current students use the scholarship system.
Renewal & obligations
Submit transcripts/receipts on time; take at least four Mandarin courses or obtain an approved exemption. Taiwan government funding is incompatible.
Application timing
Standing scheme, normally one year per award and up to the regulated undergraduate period, generally four years; confirm the current bachelor admission cycle.
  • NYCU — University Scholarships ↗
  • NYCU — International Student Scholarship FAQ ↗

NCKU Distinguished International Student Scholarship — Bachelor’s

National Cheng Kung University · China

Eligibility
International undergraduate applicants undergo university review; work-visa holders and those with employment status on their ARC are excluded.
Funding
For entrants from AY2026/27: tuition waiver and a monthly stipend determined by the college. The earlier NTD 8,000 stipend is not assumed for new entrants.
How to apply
First-year awards are assessed from admission documents without extra scholarship documents; the result accompanies admission.
Renewal & obligations
Reapply for renewal under the new rules; Taiwan government international-student funding is incompatible. Deferred admission requires reassessment.
Application timing
Standing mechanism for entrants from AY2026/27; follows the relevant admission cycle, rather than confirming a bachelor call is currently open.
  • NCKU — Degree Scholarships, updated 2026-08-31 ↗

MUIC Scholarship for Asian Students from Low-Income Countries

Mahidol University International College · Thailand

Eligibility
Current criteria concern nationality and high-school study in eligible low-income Asian countries. Ask MUIC to confirm Myanmar eligibility.
Funding
50% tuition waiver for four years; four awards yearly.
How to apply
Submit a scholarship request letter, portfolio and admission documents during the application period.
Renewal & obligations
Maintain cumulative GPA above 3.00 each trimester and graduate within four years. Confirm other award terms.
Application timing
Programme updated in May 2026; no current deadline is shown. The 2027 cycle requires confirmation.
  • MUIC Scholarships, updated 7 May 2026 ↗

Monash High Achiever Award — new students

Monash University Malaysia · Malaysia

Eligibility
International students with outstanding accepted senior-secondary results and a full offer. Listed medicine/pharmacy programmes and prior tertiary study or credit-transfer applicants are excluded.
Funding
RM10,000 annual tuition waiver, allocated RM5,000 per semester.
How to apply
Eligible admission applications are considered automatically; awards accompany the admission offer.
Renewal & obligations
Meet the offer’s maintenance score, take 24 credits per semester and finish on time; no concurrent financial assistance.
Application timing
Standing mechanism; deadlines follow course applications. Check the current intake schedule.

Sunway University / Jeffrey Cheah Foundation · Malaysia

Pearson Malaysia and Universiti Malaya · Malaysia

NUS ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship

NUS · Singapore

Eligibility
Myanmar citizens are explicitly included; outstanding school results, activities and leadership are required for a first full-time undergraduate degree. Transfer applicants are excluded.
Funding
Full subsidised tuition after MOE Tuition Grant, plus living, accommodation and one-time computer allowances.
How to apply
Eligible admission applicants are automatically considered; shortlisted candidates attend interviews.
Renewal & obligations
MOE Tuition Grant requires three years of work for a Singapore-registered company; renewal GPA is at least 3.50. Medicine/dentistry have separate six-/five-year health-ministry service obligations.
Application timing
Standing mechanism tied to undergraduate admission cycles; the 2027 window is not verified. Selection is competitive.
  • NUS ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship ↗

NTU ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship

NTU · Singapore

Eligibility
Myanmar citizens are explicitly included; outstanding school results, activities and leadership are required for a first full-time undergraduate degree. Renaissance Engineering Programme is excluded.

Full subsidised tuition after MOE Tuition Grant, plus living, accommodation and one-time computer allowances.

Apply for admission first, then submit the scholarship form, essay and teacher appraisal by the qualification deadline.

MOE Tuition Grant requires three years of work for a Singapore-registered company; renewal GPA is at least 3.5/5.0. NTU also requires community involvement.

Standing mechanism tied to undergraduate admission cycles; the 2027 window is not verified. Selection is competitive.
